name: memory-update
description: Update working memory for the current session. Use this to save key facts, active goals, user corrections, or decisions that should persist across conversation turns even if history is truncated.

action.description: The operation: 'set' to create/update an entry, 'delete' to remove one, 'clear' to remove all.

key.description: Unique identifier for the memory entry. Required for 'set' and 'delete'.

category.description: Category of the entry. Required for 'set'.

content.description: The memory content to store. Required for 'set'.
